description: This PHP file contains functions related to CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) security, including session management, token generation and validation, form modification for CSRF protection, and request validation.

methods.name: store_in_session
methods.description: Stores a key/value pair in the session if the session is set.

methods.name: unset_session
methods.description: Removes a key from the session.

methods.name: get_from_session
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the session by its key, returns false if not found.

methods.name: csrfguard_generate_token
methods.description: Generates a CSRF token for a unique form name, stores it in session.

methods.name: csrfguard_validate_token
methods.description: Validates a CSRF token against the stored session value.

methods.name: csrfguard_replace_forms
methods.description: Replaces HTML form content with forms including CSRF hidden fields.

methods.name: smarty_csrf_filter
methods.description: Applies CSRF form replacement as a Smarty template output filter.

methods.name: csrfguard_start
methods.description: Validates CSRF tokens in POST requests and redirects on failure.
